pixel_perfection_legacy.title: Pixel Perfection Legacy
pixel_perfection_legacy.description: Block textures from Pixel Perfection Legacy 26.3-97.2 (Nova_Wostra and contributors, continuation of Pixel Perfection by Hugh "XSSheep" Rutland), CC BY-SA 4.0 per ADR-0003. Imported by tools/textures/src/import/import-ppl.ts: only the block PNGs laracraft needs, renamed to laracraft texture names and re-encoded without metadata (pixels unchanged). source.originalPath is relative to the pack's block texture folder. Authorship per file is decided by pixel comparison with https://github.com/Athemis/PixelPerfectionCE @ acbdb56.
